transaction: All handlers and domain consumers share caller's SQLAlchemy synchronous Connection; no nested independent commits. enqueue rejects absence of transaction.

backend.domains.dialog.ROUTES.response: raw data; shared transport wraps success once; Response objects bypass envelope

routes.aliases: Owner registers canonical source URLs and method__action aliases, case insensitive; GET HEAD POST PUT PATCH DELETE OPTIONS. assistant/match-elements maps to match_elements. Never expose Python helper functions.
routes.retired: Three original Dialog handlers enforce source 1.4.35 version gate then return an empty text/html Response, not fabricated AI output. They remain named source handlers.

jobs.enqueue: backend.jobs.enqueue(connection, kind, payload, *, dedupe_key=None, available_at=None) -> id
jobs.push: backend.jobs.enqueue_push(connection, *, userids=(), fds=(), ignore_fds=(), message, scope=None) -> id
jobs.emit: backend.jobs.emit(connection, userids, type, data, *, ignore_fds=(), scope=None) -> id
jobs.register: backend.jobs.register(kind, handler); handler(connection,payload,settings). payload contains _event_id. Registration is explicit; unknown kinds persist failure and retry.
jobs.schedule: backend.jobs.schedule(kind, seconds, payload=None); unique period dedupe, SKIP LOCKED worker concurrency
jobs.delivery: At least once. DB savepoint rolls back failed handler writes, attempts/error/backoff retained. HTTP side effects may duplicate after crash; Idempotency-Key sent for webhooks, provider support must be verified. SQL commit precedes socket transmission; Redis pubsub is wakeup only, durable rows polled if notification races commit.
jobs.worker: async backend.jobs.worker(settings, stop_event); stop signals graceful exit after current sync transaction. realtime.job_lifecycle(settings) starts and joins it.

acl.registration: backend.realtime.register_scope(name, checker); checker(connection,userid,resource_id)->bool. dialog_id built in via dialog_core.can_view_dialog; project/task authorization reused. Other domains register file_id/report_id/project_id/task_id.
acl.tombstone_invariant: Unscoped revocation/delete recipients MUST be old authorized users captured in the same locked business transaction, and payload MUST contain only required object IDs. Never send full sensitive objects with scope=None to bypass revocation checks.
acl.trusted_sender: dialog_core.send_message(...,trusted_sender=True) is an internal-only business capability, never populated from HTTP data. Used for legitimate bot reminders/meeting invitation display sender; preserves actual dialog recipients.
acl.no_fake_ack: Only receipt matching authenticated userid, actual fd and msgId sets acknowledged_at. Missing msgId never acknowledged or guessed.

installation.sql: Run backend/outbox.sql after schema.sql/security.sql during fresh init before db.configure startup reflection; no source schema edits by this owner.
installation.startup: db.configure(settings); explicit per-domain job/scope registration; realtime.install_realtime(app,settings); assistant.install_sse(app,settings); these non-JSON routes before host fallback; async with realtime.job_lifecycle(settings) in owner lifespan.
installation.websocket: /ws?action=web&token=...&language=...&platform=...; Redis monotonic numeric fd; durable per-fd delivery; TTL connection leases; PGP shared crypto; user revocation checked every delivery loop; receipt/handshake/path/encrypt/operationResult implemented.
installation.sse: /ai/invoke/stream/{stream_key}; only stream keys bound by authenticated assistant/auth accepted; revalidates stored owner/token and installed AI; forwards actual append/replace/done/id/heartbeat bytes and Last-Event-ID, no-cache/no buffering; no synthetic completion.
installation.entrypoint_changes: Not made by this owner: main/manage/shared are sole integration owner files. Do not confuse install contract with already registered API.

external_gates: No valid licensed active users/bots exist by default. Bot lookup refuses absent real bot; cannot invoke CLI bypass or fake userCreate/license.
Actual AI/appstore/plugin config.yml deployment, API credentials, provider proxy compatibility and SSE service are required. Missing install or key returns actual business error.
SMTP and Umeng credentials/device aliases required; HTTP/provider failures retained rather than acknowledged as success.

Preserved frontend actions.js 5171-5183 drops params.msgId when sending receipt. Server refuses fake ack; original client therefore may leave deliveries unacknowledged and receive at-least-once repeats. Requires explicit consumer compatibility decision and real differential acceptance.

Shared auth source checks identity disable rather than disable_at. Account writers must sync both or integration owner tighten HTTP/login/WS together; documented shared owner response retained in report.
verification: NOT_RUN: no build, lint, test, formatter, service start or git command executed. backend.tests_messaging is left for independent acceptance. Static source/implementation ledger is not branch coverage.
